note: Derivation and numerical check only; no external data. Noether's first theorem: the internal O(2) charge (chi number) is conserved although matter trades energy with the response field through the portal, because the portal depends only on |chi|^2. Second theorem: diffeomorphism invariance of the full action with gravity keeps the Hamiltonian constraint, so total energy of matter, phi and geometry is conserved while matter energy alone is not (C_EXCHANGE_DERIVED). Translations and boosts in flat space: energy, momentum and the boost charge are conserved, the last only because phi and chi share one light cone. Rotation charges need two space dimensions and are not simulated; they follow from the same symmetric conserved stress tensor. The diffeomorphism check uses the Theory Card action in a Bianchi I universe, not a general metric. Nearest known theory: Noether 1918, ADM constraint, Poincare charges of scalar fields. Not UET-distinct.
